rationale: Broad CFB ESPN/NCAA/stats.ncaa.org/Fox/Yahoo parsers, release loaders, crosswalks, rosters and enrichment eliminate substantial custom parser work.
empirical_admission_gate: A bounded real-game smoke must preserve raw/normalized separation, row/schema identities, and cross-source reconciliation before each domain is admitted.
risk_and_constraint: Large mandatory dependency surface including XGBoost; upstream data remains noncanonical and output timestamps do not automatically prove PIT eligibility.
current_action: Implement an optional SportsDataverse CFB adapter and keep the 1 GB toolchain outside the base runtime.

integration_boundary: Immutable release capture -> RawSnapshotStore -> canonical normalization
rationale: Nineteen rectangular CFB datasets and approximately 928 documented columns already provide the historical lake bootstrap used by the project.
empirical_admission_gate: Release asset hash, season/domain coverage, schema drift, source lineage, and PIT eligibility must pass independently.
risk_and_constraint: Derived ESPN/raw lineage is not independent corroboration; release tags are dataset-specific and coverage varies by season.
current_action: Retain as the bulk historical foundation and formalize release-index acquisition rather than rebuilding its rectangularization pipeline.

integration_boundary: Release catalog resolver only; no canonical schema authority
rationale: Central release-store metadata shortens discovery and refresh checks for SportsDataverse assets.
empirical_admission_gate: Resolved asset tag, URL, byte size, and content hash must match the captured manifest.
risk_and_constraint: The repository is an index/release host, not proof that every release is current, complete, or PIT-safe.
current_action: Use its release conventions in the acquisition registry; do not add the R package to production.

integration_boundary: Optional typed client behind existing credential-free acquisition evidence boundary
rationale: Generated endpoint models cover games, plays, teams, venues, recruiting, rankings and advanced metrics and reduce client maintenance.
empirical_admission_gate: Typed output must reconcile byte-for-byte field semantics against preserved direct HTTP JSON for representative endpoints.
risk_and_constraint: Generated client is not raw-evidence authority, has no GitHub release tag/license assertion in API metadata, and must not log bearer configuration.
current_action: Add an optional source-client extra and typed serialization adapter while retaining direct HTTP as the immutable raw route.

integration_boundary: Read-only analytical engine over external Parquet/JSON with no server
rationale: Direct Parquet SQL, joins, window functions and local portability fit the external historical lake and PIT assembly workload.
empirical_admission_gate: Row counts, join cardinality, chronology and output hashes must match independent Polars/reference computations.
risk_and_constraint: SQL must remain read-only for evidence inputs; extension loading and arbitrary path access require explicit control.
current_action: Pin the Python client and implement the analytical runtime boundary.

integration_boundary: Lazy transformation engine over immutable external tables
rationale: Lazy scans, streaming, Arrow interoperability and deterministic expressions fit normalization and feature computation.
empirical_admission_gate: Materialized outputs must match schema, count, missingness and hash contracts against independent validation.
risk_and_constraint: Lazy plans do not supply PIT correctness by themselves; version drift can change schemas or expressions.
current_action: Pin Polars and make it the default dataframe engine behind project interfaces.

rationale: Executable dataframe contracts reduce custom validation code at raw-to-canonical, canonical-to-PIT and training boundaries.
empirical_admission_gate: Positive and adversarial fixtures must prove nullability, range, uniqueness and schema-drift failures.
risk_and_constraint: Pandera complements rather than replaces provenance, population coverage or chronological gates.
current_action: Pin the Polars extra and add contract helpers to the data boundary.

integration_boundary: Estimator/pipeline adapter beneath ModelArtifact and protected evaluation
rationale: Mature pipelines, logistic models, calibration and metrics replace fragile homegrown training code.
empirical_admission_gate: Chronological development replay must beat or match the sealed simple baseline without leakage before promotion.
risk_and_constraint: Random train/test examples are forbidden; estimator serialization and version identity must be pinned.
current_action: Pin 1.9.0 when model-ready matrices are approved; keep current prediction contracts authoritative.

integration_boundary: GLM/count-model adapter beneath canonical model artifacts
rationale: Logistic, Poisson, generalized Poisson, negative-binomial and mixed GLM implementations directly cover planned baselines.
empirical_admission_gate: Convergence, dispersion, residual and chronological stability diagnostics must pass on real training matrices.
risk_and_constraint: Inference assumptions and formula processing can leak if time-varying inputs are assembled incorrectly.
current_action: Pin 0.14.6 for regularized/statistical baselines after model dataset approval.

rationale: Strong tabular challenger with stable sklearn integration and efficient CPU execution.
empirical_admission_gate: Must earn protected chronological lift, calibration, stability and resource value over GLM/sklearn baselines.
risk_and_constraint: Latest 3.4.0 requires Python 3.12; current host must pin 3.2.0 and control threads/seeds.
current_action: Pin 3.2.0 for Python 3.11 and implement only when POST-SUBTASK-073 inputs are ready.

rationale: Efficient alternative if XGBoost establishes that boosted trees add meaningful value or memory becomes limiting.
empirical_admission_gate: Run only after XGBoost baseline; admit only on incremental protected value or material resource advantage.
risk_and_constraint: Adding parallel tree stacks multiplies tuning and supply-chain surface without current evidence.
current_action: Keep a pinned candidate specification; do not install yet.

rationale: Native categorical handling may help only if approved model matrices retain useful categorical structure.
empirical_admission_gate: Admit after XGBoost only when categorical treatment produces development lift with controlled compute.
risk_and_constraint: Large repository/runtime and duplicated tree-stack complexity; no present empirical need.
current_action: Retain as challenger candidate, not an immediate dependency.

integration_boundary: mlflow-skinny local tracking mirror; canonical manifests remain authority
rationale: Experiment search and visualization can accelerate tournaments already designed around an MLflow adapter.
empirical_admission_gate: Round-trip export must reproduce canonical experiment IDs, inputs, metrics and artifacts without altering promotion state.
risk_and_constraint: Full MLflow has 20 mandatory dependencies and increasingly broad LLM/server scope; remote service is unnecessary.
current_action: Use mlflow-skinny 3.15.1 only when experiment execution starts.

integration_boundary: Development-only HPO adapter with sealed objective isolation
rationale: Mature samplers and pruning replace custom search while fitting existing HPO contracts.
empirical_admission_gate: Studies must be bounded, reproducible, chronological and unable to observe protected metrics.
risk_and_constraint: Default random-split examples are inapplicable and persistent studies can become hidden authority.
current_action: Pin 4.9.0 and integrate at the declared HPO work unit.

integration_boundary: Offline explanation generator; serving renders precomputed evidence only
rationale: Fast tree explanations support XGBoost/LightGBM/CatBoost/sklearn and improve forecast accountability.
empirical_admission_gate: Attribution stability and output consistency must pass on the admitted champion; no causal claims.
risk_and_constraint: Latest 0.52.0 requires Python 3.12; current host must pin 0.51.0.
current_action: Pin 0.51.0 only after a tree challenger is admitted.

rationale: Prediction intervals and sets can improve uncertainty reporting and coverage evaluation.
empirical_admission_gate: Exchangeability diagnostics, rolling calibration and regime coverage must pass; random calibration splits are forbidden.
risk_and_constraint: Football seasons are nonexchangeable and adaptive methods can still miscover under regime shift.
current_action: Pin 1.5.0 for a development-only challenger after calibrated baselines exist.

integration_boundary: Optional offline report exporter behind monitoring contracts
rationale: Broad drift/quality metrics and reports could accelerate weekly monitoring once a champion operates.
empirical_admission_gate: Must add actionable signal beyond existing schema/missingness/residual monitors with acceptable runtime cost.
risk_and_constraint: Twenty-six mandatory dependencies and service/UI scope are excessive before weekly production exists.
current_action: Retain as an operations candidate; do not install in the current critical path.

rationale: Provides a concrete fourth-down expected-value feature family.
empirical_admission_gate: Python implementation must match pinned fixtures and then earn incremental chronological value.
risk_and_constraint: Experimental R package with simplifying assumptions and post-play inputs that can leak into pregame features.
current_action: Extract hypotheses and parity fixtures only; do not embed R in production.

rationale: Could support hierarchical A&M/team effects and uncertainty when sparse-history evidence warrants it.
empirical_admission_gate: Admit only after simpler shrinkage baselines reveal a specific unmet uncertainty or pooling need.
risk_and_constraint: Heavy probabilistic runtime; latest 6.2.0 needs Python 3.12, so Python 3.11 would require 5.28.5.
current_action: Retain 5.28.5 as the compatible candidate pin; do not install now.

rationale: Mature EP/WP/data-release/update patterns are valuable independent implementation references.
empirical_admission_gate: CFB implementation must match only transferable definitions on pinned fixtures and remain source-specific.
risk_and_constraint: NFL rules/population differ; R runtime and NFL data are not production dependencies.
current_action: Use as a design comparator for releases, EP/WP and incremental enrichment.

rationale: Surfaces testable Kyle Field, home/road, attendance, penalty, turnover and opponent-strength questions.
empirical_admission_gate: Every hypothesis must be rebuilt from canonical PIT-safe data with national/SEC comparators and multiple-testing controls.
risk_and_constraint: No license/tests, notebook-only analysis, post-outcome variables and observational conclusions cannot be imported as results.
current_action: Add hypotheses to the A&M research queue; copy no conclusions or runtime code.

rationale: Inspection found only direct CFBD schedule/roster calls already covered more robustly by project sources; no unique A&M acquisition path was present.
empirical_admission_gate: None; the candidate adds no distinct capability.
risk_and_constraint: No license/tests, hard-coded years/facts, OpenAI 0.28.1/Chroma coupling, broad exception swallowing, and a UTC conversion defect.
current_action: Do not adopt code or RAG architecture; retain the negative finding.

integration_boundary: Multi-field probabilistic linkage after deterministic/RapidFuzz candidate generation
rationale: Fellegi-Sunter linkage on DuckDB fits player/coach records with multiple partially reliable attributes.
empirical_admission_gate: Labeled cross-source pairs must establish precision/recall and thresholds; unresolved/ambiguous cases remain quarantined.
risk_and_constraint: Not suitable for single-name linking; correlation and sparse fields can produce overconfident matches.
current_action: Pin 4.0.16 and add a settings builder, but prohibit automatic canonical promotion until BAT-388 validation.

integration_boundary: Candidate generation only before deterministic/probabilistic review
rationale: Fast zero-runtime-dependency similarity metrics materially reduce manual candidate search.
empirical_admission_gate: Adversarial aliases and labeled pairs must prove recall; scores never auto-accept an identity.
risk_and_constraint: RapidFuzz 3 does no preprocessing by default, so project normalization must remain explicit.
current_action: Pin 3.14.5 and implement a bounded candidate generator immediately.

integration_boundary: Pinned R reference outputs and taxonomy only
rationale: Established CFB play processing and EP/WP interfaces provide independent parity targets.
empirical_admission_gate: Python outputs must match pinned cases with documented semantic differences and chronology.
risk_and_constraint: R runtime would duplicate production and CFBD wrappers; derived metrics are not independent truth.
current_action: Use for EPA/WPA/play taxonomy parity tests, not as a runtime dependency.

rationale: Brier, log, CRPS, energy and threshold-weighted scores directly cover forecast distributions and BAS tails.
empirical_admission_gate: Orientation, sample weighting, tail thresholds and reference calculations must pass before protected use.
risk_and_constraint: Latest 0.11.0 requires Python 3.12; current host must pin 0.10.0.
current_action: Pin 0.10.0 and implement at probabilistic evaluation readiness.

integration_boundary: Optional distributional model behind model contracts
rationale: Direct predictive distributions align with score, margin and BAS-tail outputs.
empirical_admission_gate: Must beat point-model-plus-calibration baselines on chronological NLL/CRPS/calibration and resource cost.
risk_and_constraint: Examples use random splits; distributional misspecification can create misleading tails.
current_action: Pin 0.5.11 for the model tournament after baseline approval.

integration_boundary: EBM candidate behind model and explanation contracts
rationale: Provides nonlinear glass-box behavior between GLM and black-box boosted trees.
empirical_admission_gate: Must earn chronological lift and stable explanations relative to GLM/XGBoost.
risk_and_constraint: Native extension footprint and interaction search require deterministic resource controls.
current_action: Pin 0.7.8 and evaluate EBM in the model tournament.

rationale: Property-based generation directly targets PIT boundaries, identity stability, probability coherence and temporal edge cases.
empirical_admission_gate: Deterministic profiles must reproduce minimal failures and never access protected outcomes.
risk_and_constraint: Generated cases complement but cannot replace real-data population validation.
current_action: Pin 6.165.2 and add entity/PIT invariants immediately.

integration_boundary: Optional decoder/client after immutable HTTP capture
rationale: Efficient FlatBuffers and NumPy/Polars access reduce historical weather parsing work.
empirical_admission_gate: Forecast-run identity and initialization must be preserved; realized archive weather is explicitly non-PIT for pregame forecasts.
risk_and_constraint: Uses niquests/openmeteo-sdk; decoded arrays are not substitutes for immutable raw response identity.
current_action: Pin 1.7.5 and add a weather decoder adapter while direct HTTP remains the raw-evidence route.

rationale: An online feature store is unnecessary for the local weekly batch product and duplicates the feature/PIT registries.
empirical_admission_gate: Reconsider only if a measured online serving requirement appears.
risk_and_constraint: Service and dependency complexity exceed present value.
current_action: Do not add.

rationale: Existing local scheduler and Jira DAG already cover required orchestration.
empirical_admission_gate: Reconsider only for a demonstrated multi-worker scheduling gap.
risk_and_constraint: Large service/database operational burden.
current_action: Do not add.

empirical_admission_gate: Reconsider only after a measured orchestration reliability gap.
risk_and_constraint: Adds daemon/UI/storage surface.
current_action: Do not add.

rationale: Current local-first scheduling does not need a second workflow control plane.
empirical_admission_gate: Reconsider only for a measured remote orchestration need.

current_action: Do not add.

rationale: Current national history fits local DuckDB/Polars and has no distributed-compute evidence.
empirical_admission_gate: Reconsider only when measured workloads exceed the local resource envelope.
risk_and_constraint: JVM/cluster complexity and duplicated dataframe semantics.
current_action: Do not add.

empirical_admission_gate: Reconsider only after bounded local parallelism fails measured targets.

current_action: Do not add.

current_action: Do not add; retain project manifests.

rationale: Pandera provides the needed lightweight dataframe contract layer while existing validators cover provenance and coverage.
empirical_admission_gate: Reconsider only if Pandera cannot express a measured production requirement.

rationale: Neural sequence models remain plausible only after conventional baselines expose a specific gap.
empirical_admission_gate: Protected admission requires incremental chronological lift, calibration, stability and resource value.

current_action: Retain as conditional P3; do not install now.

rationale: Graph structure may eventually model schedules/teams/players if simpler relational features saturate.
empirical_admission_gate: Require an explicit graph hypothesis, leakage-safe edges and lift over tabular baselines.

current_action: Retain as conditional P3; do not install now.
